'''Jason Robinette''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 3 from New York City, NY. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

[[File:Jason Robinette Times Square 1999.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Robinette in Times Square, New York, 1999]]

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Red 3 || New York City, NY || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Robinette playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
